nahhas-meani:112-112.t:
Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ said, from Mujāhid: I asked Ibn ʿAbbās and he said: Sūrat al-Ḥajj was revealed in Mecca, except for three verses of it, which were revealed in Medina concerning six men of Quraysh: three of them believers and three disbelievers.
As for the believers, they were "Ḥamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib", "ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib" and "ʿUbayda ibn al-Ḥārith", may Allah be pleased with them.
"ʿUtba" and "Shayba", the two sons of Rabīʿa, and "al-Walīd ibn ʿUtba" challenged them to single combat; so Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, revealed three Medinan verses, namely His saying, exalted is He: ﴿هَذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوْا في رَبِّهِمْ﴾ to the completion of the three verses from that point.
